cases.title: First Copy
cases.aha: Deterministic deduplication needs only the last admitted key, but the retained payload must come from the canonical first source event.

cases.title: Duplicate Dispatch
cases.aha: A duplicate can be temporally feasible; suppression is justified by a public identity/body contract and an explicit accepted survivor, not by calling the retry inconsistent.

cases.title: Silent Timeout
cases.aha: Cancellation is an absence-producing state transition, not another delayed event; external commands at the deadline invalidate the timer before phase-1 execution.

cases.title: Shared Wall
cases.aha: Union coverage proves that an edge appears somewhere; coverage multiplicity proves that distinct transformed surveys independently corroborate the shared boundary.

cases.title: Cold Platform
cases.aha: The controller acted on ingestion time, but the retained sample's observation time is the authorized causal time; capacity is a tempting but expensive misdiagnosis.

cases.title: Priority Queue
cases.aha: The public priority order is not the executor order: an earlier non-preemptive grant must move beyond the medical arrival, while an equal tick still preserves the inversion.

cases.title: Black Ice
cases.aha: Treatment effectiveness and closure are not separate repairs: they must meet at the single tick after ambulance clearance and before the school bus arrives.

cases.title: Borrowed Pressure
cases.aha: The fire pump is healthy; pressure is the observable result of two independently authorized loads overlapping on one feeder.

cases.title: Lost Acknowledgment
cases.aha: A gap in source sequence induces an order edge between the surviving records; it does not justify fabricating the missing acknowledgment.

cases.title: Rotated Block
cases.aha: Eight D4-equivalent assemblies are one history; stable comparison requires the lexicographically least attributed-edge encoding.

cases.title: Token Window
cases.aha: A correct bucket refills and clamps before each canonical request, but only the admitted branch consumes a token; rejection is not a hidden debit.

cases.title: Island Signal
cases.aha: Daily energy is irrelevant at the ambulance tick: the signal capacitor must finish before crossing service while the clinic retains its instantaneous minimum power.

cases.title: Compensating Transfer
cases.aha: A completed transfer remains in the archive; a later equal-and-opposite compensation fixes the balance, while causal intervals expose a claimed rollback as impossible.

cases.title: Last Train Through
cases.aha: Boarding, signed ventilation, traction reserve, island capacity, travel time, and bridge closure collapse to one feasible rail departure boundary; a bus bridge is valid but cannot explain the rail history.

cases.title: Split Brain
cases.aha: A partitioned writer is an indivisible evidence branch: choose one complete journal, prove the combined source order impossible, and resist splicing a synthetic third history.

cases.title: Two of Three
cases.aha: Quorum counts distinct sources rather than messages; the one-shot output must retain the canonical payload of the event that supplies the second independent attestation.

cases.title: Cooling Window
cases.aha: Cooling flow is bounded from below by temperature and from above by grid draw; pipe saturation makes exactly one replacement value satisfy both contracts.

cases.title: Quorum Ledger
cases.aha: A temporally feasible record can still lose under a public evidence contract: retain every vote for the unique three-replica claim and label the stale pair as minority, not inconsistent.

cases.title: Missing Tile
cases.aha: A bounded hole is not free invention: the missing interior vertex and exactly its incident edges must match observed coverage, and a public coordinate checksum fixes every inferred attribute.

cases.title: The Open Bridge
cases.aha: Wind safety gives a lower bound on opening while the ambulance gives an upper bound after accounting for mechanical duration; the bounds meet at exactly one command tick.

cases.title: Clock Islands
cases.aha: Intervals belong to records, but offsets belong to clock domains: three records on one island must share one offset before cross-island messages can order the history.

cases.title: Double Exposure
cases.aha: Local names and orientation do not create independent evidence: a D4-normalized attributed fingerprint identifies one cached survey as a duplicate and binds it to one used survivor.

cases.title: Barrier at Dawn
cases.aha: An all-topic barrier differs from quorum: duplicates and any two subsystems are insufficient, and the canonical event that completes all three must be the sole release payload.

cases.title: Three Departments
cases.aha: A wind floor and a public deadline squeeze three independent departmental clocks into one lawful handoff schedule; every retained log must move.

cases.title: Conflict Component
cases.aha: A useful conflict certificate is inclusion-minimal: the pair is jointly impossible, but removing either member restores a feasible history.

cases.title: False Landmark
cases.aha: A fragment can fit the attributed graph yet remain historically impossible because every geometric embedding violates its retained public landmark.

cases.title: Backpressure
cases.aha: Queue depth changes only on admitted requests and effective drains; rejection is neither a hidden debit nor future capacity.

cases.title: One Timetable
cases.aha: A public UTC timetable collapses distinct operator services, so a lawful bidirectional update needs one identity complement plus every hidden operational fact.

cases.title: Silent Gauge
cases.aha: When the gauge is missing, the repair must satisfy the complete calibrated uncertainty envelope rather than one guessed hidden reading.

cases.title: Minimal Cut
cases.aha: A minimum-weight hitting set can preserve more evidence than deleting one record from each conflict independently; the shared gateway cuts both.

cases.title: Timestamp Gauge
cases.aha: Uniform topology leaves many embeddings, but per-vertex scan times minus a fragment offset recover the absolute row-major placement.

cases.title: Warm Failover
cases.aha: Availability and standby readiness are different state: fail over only after a real warm signal and restore primary preference on recovery.

cases.title: Dispatch Covenant
cases.aha: Two local policies must preserve safety and bounded response under every fair asynchronous schedule without reading one another's hidden state.

cases.title: Shadow Bus
cases.aha: A hidden capacity interval and a visible train limit force one robust two-vehicle allocation: promise only the bus minimum and put the exact remainder on rail.

cases.title: Echoed Update
cases.aha: Transitive duplication is proved by a rooted direct-predecessor chain, not merely matching bodies or linking every echo straight to the original.

cases.title: Broken Ring
cases.aha: A published simple-cycle contract licenses exactly one uncovered perimeter edge when all vertices are observed and the remaining cycle is one path.

cases.title: Exactly Once
cases.aha: Completion belongs to the logical operation rather than either route, so tombstones survive failover while availability only selects the first execution path.

cases.title: Two Histories
cases.aha: Two distinct internal tips collapse to one public record; a lawful bidirectional correction needs one history discriminator while sealed deltas and audit lineage survive every edit.

cases.title: Redacted Feeder
cases.aha: A whole-event projection redaction hides an authorized feeder without deleting it from active state; a digest binds its restricted provenance without disclosure.

cases.title: Evidence Weight
cases.aha: Independent source weights, not record count, select the unique claim; all winning evidence survives and every losing source is explicitly outvoted.

cases.title: Adversarial Survey
cases.aha: An embeddable noisy survey is rejected only when correct used support outweighs it by the public margin on every conflicting mapped edge.

cases.title: Shared Deadline
cases.aha: Signals with different allowances join one batch at the earliest absolute deadline; keyed replacement moves a live timer earlier without duplicate expiry.

cases.title: Witness Gap
cases.aha: One bounded latent cause must explain three retained observations simultaneously; competing causes fail explicit exclusion evidence and no second invention is allowed.

cases.title: Policy Blind Spot
cases.aha: A byte-identical public projection can cover both an unsafe and safe route; active sealed thermal state, not the display tile, determines policy safety.

cases.title: Causal Compression
cases.aha: Retain every fact but replace seven authentic precedence links with a four-edge transitive reduction whose every edge is necessary.

cases.title: Underground Layer
cases.aha: Two connected edge layers meet at exactly the published shaft portals; flattening depth produces mixed junctions unsupported by portal material.

cases.title: Burst Budget
cases.aha: A half-open sliding window remembers only admitted times, distinguishes simultaneous requests, and returns capacity exactly at the boundary.

cases.title: City Covenant
cases.aha: Dispatch cannot observe sealed heat directly; a local sensor must publish the distinguishing fact before a safe layer-specific route can be committed.

cases.title: Equivocation
cases.aha: Equivocation taints every record from the source-operation pair, including the statement that happens to agree with honest witnesses.

cases.title: Whole City
cases.aha: Three overlapping non-square strips establish both whole-city edge coverage and the exact connected boundary between surface and underground layers.

cases.title: Reorder Buffer
cases.aha: A late lower index can release an entire buffered contiguous prefix; forwarding one arrival or draining one item is insufficient.

cases.title: The Missing Cause
cases.aha: A two-event latent explanation is accepted only when the complete pair establishes safety and every proper subset fails under independent replay.

cases.title: Correction Notice
cases.aha: A trustworthy correction preserves the false prior statement and publishes an explicit superseding edge to the evidence-backed counterfactual.

cases.title: Two Consistent Archives
cases.aha: Two complete schedules can satisfy every retained interval and edge; canonical selection must not misclassify the alternative as inconsistent.

cases.title: Circuit Breaker
cases.aha: Closed, open, and half-open are distinct states: after cooldown exactly one request probes until a real success or failure resolves it.

cases.title: Competing Amendments
cases.aha: When two amendments are safe, a public canonical order selects one reproducibly while preserving the other as a valid alternative.

cases.title: Audit Window
cases.aha: Operational cooldown does not extend legal time; the retained filing must move to the inclusive closing tick without changing its evidence.

cases.title: Rule of Least Change
cases.aha: Global contract logic can make one physical correction cheaper than repairing every visible symptom independently.

cases.title: The Reconstruction
cases.aha: A complete city archive is a canonical representative plus a minimal partial order: it preserves four feasible schedules and refuses to invent an order between independently established safe routes.

cases.title: City Clock
cases.aha: A citywide barrier is cyclic: the completing source emits once and atomically clears the round, so a duplicate after completion belongs to the next epoch.

cases.title: Continuity Hearing
cases.aha: Independently valid evidence is not jointly valid until archive, controller, and policy are bound to one hearing epoch.

cases.title: The Chosen Tomorrow
cases.aha: Applying a public selector chooses one safe history without deleting the other, while the public projection preserves safety and multiplicity but hides route.

cases.title: Two Tomorrows
cases.aha: Two policy-checked safe histories can have byte-identical public records; the final certificate binds both replays, both safety proofs, and a semantic latent-route difference.
